summary: First the edge of a roof, then all space. With 宙 it makes 宇宙, the universe.
placement: Chosen by farthest-point sampling on the integrated Burke–Shaw trajectory, so the eight stars spread across its projected shape. 遠 takes the point farthest from the system’s centre, 孤 the most isolated of the rest, and 寂 the point nearest the centre. A design choice, not a claim.

satellites.title: The Edge of a Roof
satellites.evidence: The Shuowen: 宇，屋邊也 — the eaves. The word for all of space began as the edge of a roof, the line between shelter and sky.
satellites.caveat: Wording from general knowledge; check an edition.

satellites.title: Real, but Located Nowhere
satellites.evidence: Zhuangzi 23 (Gengsang Chu): 有實而無乎處者，宇也；有長而無本剽者，宙也 — “what is real but has no place is 宇, space; what has length but neither root nor tip is 宙, time.”
